commands.command: CLI join ownership, native permissions and group reply recovery
commands.stderr: A real CLI-created Codex joined under the canonical first local user, invisible to a different frontend account. Membership and a connected poller did not prove a usable group reply. Native CLI built-ins bypass ClawCross command sandbox; ACP allowed_tools is advisory. Report owner and Agent readiness separately, retain the normal group APIs, default new joins to isolated workspaces with native execution disabled, expose a native off switch, and persist normal group reply targets across restart. Do not relax the host-only app SDK proxy to make an old test pass.
